item.text:
Done. Thunderbird now has a send-only Outlook identity for `anonym-x2024@outlook.com` using:

`SMTP`: `smtp-mail.outlook.com`  
`Port`: `587`  
`Security`: `STARTTLS`  
`Auth`: `OAuth2 / Modern Auth`

I configured it on a `Local Folders` account with incoming server type `none`, so no IMAP or POP incoming service was added. Thunderbird is open now as `Local Folders - Mozilla Thunderbird`.

On first send, Microsoft will likely prompt for Outlook sign-in/OAuth authorization. I used Microsoft’s current Outlook.com SMTP settings as the source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/pop-imap-and-smtp-settings-for-outlook-com-d088b986-291d-42b8-9564-9c414e2aa040
